description: Search Slovak methodological guidance (PDF documents): Financna sprava SR (metodicke pokyny, usmernenia, zavery komisii, prehlady zmluv o zamedzeni dvojitemu zdaneniu), MF SR Financny spravodajca (from 2010), NBS metodicke usmernenia and stanoviska, UVO (only when enabled). Hybrid mode fuses full-text (sk_unaccent: case and diacritics are ignored, NO stemming, so inflected forms do not match) and vector ranking over the passages with reciprocal rank fusion. Each hit gives id, fonte, source_id, ente, tipo, section, numero, anno, data, oggetto, a highlight (headline, only for a full-text match), a short snippet (best passage, at most 700 characters), text_source (pdf or ocr) and source_url (the PDF, the binding text). Read the full text with sk-metodika_doc by id. Parameters: query (web-search syntax), k (1..50, default 10), mode (hybrid, lexical, semantic), filters fonte, section, tipo (case-insensitive), ente (substring), anno_from, anno_to, data_from, data_to. With no query the documents are listed by tipo, anno, numero (a call without any parameter lists the first page). Guidance is not a source of law. Example: {"query": "metodicky pokyn dan z prijmov", "fonte": "financnasprava", "anno_from": 2024}.
